versions.changelog:
qywx-notify 1.0.0 initial release:

- Send notifications to WeChat Work (WeCom) group chats via robot webhook.
- Supports text, image (Markdown format), and rich Markdown messages.
- Includes CLI and code-based invocation, with optional @all mention.
- Features robust error handling, auto retry on failure, and common usage examples.
- Provides integration guidance for Node.js and Python.
- Details security best practices and troubleshooting steps.
